resources.string: Watch setup from phone
Install and enable the watch companion
Save or share the watch APK, copy its overlay command, and open Bugjaeger.

1. On the watch, enable Developer options, ADB debugging, and Wireless debugging. Connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi. In Bugjaeger on this phone, pair with the watch using its pairing code, then connect using its connection port. Pairing and connection ports can differ. Select the watch as the target.
A matching watch APK is included in this phone build. Save it for an ADB client, or share it with a compatible app.
Checking for the bundled watch APK…
This phone build does not include a watch APK. Use the matching watch APK supplied with your release. Command copying and opening Bugjaeger still work.
Save watch APK
Share watch APK
2. In Bugjaeger, select the watch, open Packages, tap +, and choose the saved watch APK. With another ADB client, use its APK installation flow.
3. Open the selected watch’s interactive shell and paste this command. Bugjaeger is already inside the shell, so paste it exactly as shown.
Watch overlay shell command
Copy watch shell command
Open Bugjaeger
4. Open ANeko on the watch and start its overlay. Return to the phone and choose Automatic to move the companion between devices.
4. Open ANeko on the watch and start its overlay. FOSS companions run independently. Moving one companion between devices requires the connected build on both devices.

Shizuku running on this phone provides privileges on this phone. Setting up the watch still requires an ADB connection to the watch. APK sharing also works with other compatible clients; Bugjaeger is optional.
